say:1:1711138001:1.text: The item has finally been returned to its rightful owner, and I have done my duty.
say:1:1711138001:1.source_cn: 终于物归原主了，在下也算是不负所托。

choice_prompt:4:1711138003.text: But who could blame me when this matter was negotiated by a powerful figure whom I could not refuse under any circumstances?
choice_prompt:4:1711138003.source_cn: 可谁让这件事……是被一位在下无论如何也无法拒绝的大人物说和的呢？

say:5:1711138004:1.text: You don't even remember this, yet you can still accurately recite the code...
say:5:1711138004:1.source_cn: 您连这个都不记得，竟然还能准确无误地说出暗号……

say:6:1711138005:1.text: I suddenly regret it; I shouldn't have returned it to you directly.
say:6:1711138005:1.source_cn: 在下突然有些后悔了，不应该直接还给您才是。

choice_prompt:7:1711138005.text: I suddenly regret it; I shouldn't have returned it to you directly.
choice_prompt:7:1711138005.source_cn: 在下突然有些后悔了，不应该直接还给您才是。

say:8:1711138006:1.text: The client's personal privacy is a top secret, and as for that person's identity... I must keep it a secret even more.
say:8:1711138006:1.source_cn: 客户的个人隐私是顶级机密，至于那位的身份……在下更是要保密。

choice_prompt:10:1711138007.text: I'm sorry, Lord Merlin, even if you bring me the most exclusive information this time, I cannot reveal a single bit to you.
choice_prompt:10:1711138007.source_cn: 抱歉了，梅林阁下，这次就算你拿来再独家的情报，我也无法向你透露分毫。

say:11:1711138008:1.text: How could that be? I have basic professional ethics.
say:11:1711138008:1.source_cn: 怎么会呢？在下有基本的职业操守。

say:13:1711138010:1.text: At most, I just happen to know a little bit of harmless inside information.
say:13:1711138010:1.source_cn: 在下顶多只是……恰好知道一点点无伤大雅的内幕而已。

say:14:1711138011:1.text: As for what earth-shattering secret is hidden within this Star of Memory, please unseal it for yourself.
say:14:1711138011:1.source_cn: 至于这颗记忆之星里究竟藏着什么惊天秘密，就请阁下自行解封吧。

choice:10:0:1.text: Did you already know what was inside?
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 你是不是早就知道里面是什么了？

choice:7:0:1.text: Don't change the subject, who is this important person?
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 别转移话题，大人物是谁？
